text: DIAGNOSIS READY: Reactive Arthritis (Reiter's Syndrome). The combination of urethritis (painful urination), recent aseptic arthritis (knee and previous ankle), and normal inflammatory markers despite symptoms is classic for this seronegative spondyloarthropathy.
